correctness.rationale: The coefficient identity is derived directly from the dihedral product. Offset coordinates force each coefficient row to be affine in the basis index. The remaining two functional equations diagonalize in the monomial basis of functions on the nonzero prime-field elements and select exactly the odd exponents satisfying 2^(t+1)=1. There are two independent derivations per exponent, and counting admissible exponents gives the displayed lcm formula. The packaged checker verifies both the explicit basis and independent nullities.
